carousels.title: What a Saturn return actually is

slides.head: A Saturn return is not a birthday.
slides.alt: Cream card with a gold orbit dial. Large text: A Saturn return is not a birthday. Small text: Saturn in Aries until 12 Apr 2028.

slides.text: Saturn takes about 29.5 years to go round the Sun. Your return is when it gets back to the degree it held the day you were born.
slides.alt: Text slide: Saturn takes about 29.5 years to go round the Sun. Your return is when it gets back to the degree it held the day you were born.

slides.text: It spends two to three years in that sign while it does it. That's your window.
slides.alt: Text slide with an orbit dial whose gold arc runs from where Saturn enters your sign to where it leaves. Text: It spends two to three years in that sign while it does it. That's your window.

slides.text: Inside the window: one exact pass, or three if Saturn goes backwards over your degree. Those are the dates.
slides.alt: Text slide: Inside the window: one exact pass, or three if Saturn goes backwards over your degree. Those are the dates.

slides.head: Three phases.
slides.alt: Text slide headed Three phases, listing Approach: pressure, no verdict. Contact: the pass. Integration: what you chose becomes structure.

slides.text: It happens around 27–30, again around 56–60, again around 85–88. Same maths, different question each time.
slides.alt: Text slide: It happens around 27 to 30, again around 56 to 60, again around 85 to 88. Same maths, different question each time.

slides.text: Saturn describes the work, not what happens to you. Nothing here predicts an event.
slides.alt: Text slide: Saturn describes the work, not what happens to you. Nothing here predicts an event.

slides.head: Your window and your passes, free, in ten seconds.
slides.alt: Closing slide: Your window and your passes, free, in ten seconds. rite.report
